div.div: مُمْرِجٌ A she-camel ejecting her embryo, or the seed of the stallion, in a state consisting of, or after its becoming, what is termed غِرْس [or matter resembling mucus] and blood. (TA.) A camel that usually does so is termed ↓ مِمْرَاجٌ . (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
